### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first include the reactivity gene expression matrix and the supplied experiment matrix.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

experiment_matrix_df <- data.table::fread("01-alignment/input_files/nfcore_sampleinfo.csv", data.table = F)
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,2]
experiment_matrix_df$replicate <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,1]
experiment_matrix_df <- experiment_matrix_df[,-c(2,3,4)]
experiment_matrix_df$condition <- ifelse(experiment_matrix_df$replicate %in% c("C1", "C2", "C6"), "Control", "ALS")

experiment_matrix_df$isogenic <- ifelse(experiment_matrix_df$replicate %in% c("NCRM6", "C6"), "TRUE", "FALSE")
experiment_matrix_df$isogenic <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$isogenic, levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
experiment_matrix_df$condition <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$condition, levels = c("Control", "ALS"))
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$ERAP, levels = c("CTRL", "ERAP2"))
experiment_matrix_df <- unique(experiment_matrix_df)
experiment_matrix_df$group <- paste(experiment_matrix_df$condition, experiment_matrix_df$ERAP, sep = "_")

```

### 3.0 Perform differential expression profiling

- Import counts matrix

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

gene_expression_matrix <- read.table("01-alignment/merged/star_rsem/rsem.merged.gene_counts.tsv", header = T)
rownames(gene_expression_matrix) <- gene_expression_matrix[,1]
gene_expression_matrix <- gene_expression_matrix[,match(experiment_matrix_df$sample, colnames(gene_expression_matrix))]

```

### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf.

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("GenomicFeatures")
annotation_gtf <- "/nemo/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

a_txdb_object <- makeTxDbFromGRanges(annotation_ranges)
exon_ranges <- exonicParts(a_txdb_object, linked.to.single.gene.only = T)
exon_ranges$length <- width(exon_ranges)
gene_lengths <- vapply(split(exon_ranges$length, exon_ranges$gene_id), sum,1)

keep_pcg_genes <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id[annotation_gene_ranges$type == "gene" & annotation_gene_ranges$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"]
pcg_expression_matrix <- gene_expression_matrix[rownames(gene_expression_matrix) %in% keep_pcg_genes,]

annotation_df <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(gene_expression_matrix))
annotation_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(gene_expression_matrix), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
annotation_df$biotype <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_biotype[match(rownames(gene_expression_matrix), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
annotation_df$length <- gene_lengths[annotation_df$gene_id]

```

# Perform differential gene expression using DESeq2

- Perform differential expression profiling in whole cells 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

current_experiment_df <- experiment_matrix_df
# [experiment_matrix_df$replicate != "C2",]

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(gene_expression_matrix[,current_experiment_df$sample]),
    colData = current_experiment_df,
    design = ~ condition + ERAP + condition:ERAP)

# de_lrt_object <- DESeq(dds, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ ERAP + condition)

dds_vst <- assay(vst(dds))

# dds_vst[annotation_df$gene_id[annotation_df$gene_name == "ERAP2" & !is.na(annotation_df$gene_name)],]


```

- Perform Plot of deseq2 object 

```{r fig.cap = "PCA plot of DESeq2 samples differentially expressed genes", include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# rownames(dds_vst) <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(dds_vst), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
pca_object <- pca(log(dds_vst), metadata = colData(dds), removeVar = 0.1)

new_names <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(pca_object$loadings), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
duplicated_names <- new_names[new_names %in% new_names[duplicated(new_names)]]
new_names[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names] <- rownames(pca_object$loadings)[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names ]

rownames(pca_object$loadings) <- new_names

pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "01-pca_plot.pdf"))
  biplot(pca_object, showLoadings = F,
    labSize = 3, 
    pointSize = 3, 
    sizeLoadingsNames = 3,
    colby = "condition",
    legendPosition = "bottom",
    hline = 0,
    vline = 0)
dev.off()

```

- Perform differential expression profiling with DESeq2

```{r}

# counts(de_object, normalized = T)["ENSG00000009709",]

# boo <- norm_matrix["ENSG00000009709",]
  #   C2_CTRL    C2_ERAP2     C6_CTRL    C6_ERAP2  NCRM6_CTRL NCRM6_ERAP2
  # 0.0000000   0.0000000   0.6073596   0.7412841  98.8344881 106.7344930
  # GliA_CTRL  GliA_ERAP2    C1_ERAP2   GliB_CTRL  GliB_ERAP2     C1_CTRL
  # 1.6832703   0.7482754   0.9141798  45.6800174  49.4331749   0.0000000

de_object <- DESeq(dds)
model_matrix <- model.matrix(design(de_object), colData(de_object))

als_vs_control <- colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & 
    de_object$condition == "ALS",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & 
    de_object$condition == "Control",])
de_object_als_vs_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = als_vs_control)
nrow(de_object_als_vs_ctrl[!is.na(de_object_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue) & de_object_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue < 0.05,])
# 878
nrow(de_object_als_vs_ctrl[!is.na(de_object_als_vs_ctrl$padj) & de_object_als_vs_ctrl$padj < 0.05,])
# 6


top_events <- de_object_als_vs_ctrl[!is.na(de_object_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue) & de_object_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue < 0.05,]
top_events[order(top_events$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]


erap2_kd_in_control <- colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "ERAP2" & de_object$condition == "Control",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & de_object$condition == "Control",])
de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = erap2_kd_in_control)
nrow(de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl[!is.na(de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl$pvalue) & de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl$pvalue < 0.05,])
# 1420


erap2_kd_in_als <- colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "ERAP2" & de_object$condition == "ALS",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & de_object$condition == "ALS",])
de_object_erap2_kd_als <- results(de_object, contrast = erap2_kd_in_als)
nrow(de_object_erap2_kd_als[!is.na(de_object_erap2_kd_als$pvalue) & de_object_erap2_kd_als$pvalue < 0.05,])
# 1758

# isogenic_als_vs_control <- model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & de_object$condition == "ALS" & de_object$isogenic == "TRUE",] - model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & de_object$condition == "Control" & de_object$isogenic == "TRUE",]
# de_object_isogenic_als_vs_control <- results(de_object, contrast = isogenic_als_vs_control)
# nrow(de_object_isogenic_als_vs_control[!is.na(de_object_isogenic_als_vs_control$pvalue) & de_object_isogenic_als_vs_control$pvalue < 0.05,])
# 84



# effect_of_erap2_on_als_vs_control <- effect_of_erap2_on_als_vs_control

de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl <- results(de_object, 
    contrast = list("condition_ALS_vs_Control", "conditionALS.ERAPERAP2"))
de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl[!is.na(de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue) & de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue < 0.05,]

all_de_object_list <- list(
    "als_vs_ctrl" = de_object_als_vs_ctrl,
    "erap2_kd_effect_in_control" = de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl,
    "erap2_kd_effect_in_als" = de_object_erap2_kd_als,
    # "genetic_effect_of_als" = de_object_isogenic_als_vs_control,
    "effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl" = de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl)

saveRDS(object = list(vst_matrix = dds_vst, 
    differential_object = de_object,
    contrasts = all_de_object_list,
    annotation = annotation_df),
    file = file.path(rdata_dir, "01-DESeq2-merged-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))

```

- Save as csv 

```{r}

require("enrichR")

significant_events <- function(x){
    return(x[x$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(x$pvalue),])
}


differentially_expressed_events_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_de_object_list), function(x){
    event_df <- significant_events(all_de_object_list[[x]])
    event_df$direction <- ifelse(event_df$log2FoldChange < 0, "down", "up")
    event_df$gene_name <- annotation_df[match(rownames(event_df), annotation_df$gene_id),"gene_name"]
    event_df$contrast <- x
    return(event_df)
}))

write.csv(differentially_expressed_events_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "01-differentially-expressed-events-pvalue-lt-0.05.csv"))

```

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}

require("enrichR")
protein_split <- split(differentially_expressed_events_df, differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast)

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(protein_split)
directions <- c("up", "down")
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    return_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
                message(paste(a_database, a_direction, a_group))
                current_fcs <- a_temp_df$log2FoldChange[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                current_genes <- a_temp_df$gene_name[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
                if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                    return(NULL)
                }
                an_enrichment_df$direction <- a_direction
                an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
                an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
                Sys.sleep(5)
                return(an_enrichment_df)
            })
            db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
        }))
    return_df$contrasts <- a_group
    return(return_df)
}))


kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)

annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path("14-erap2-kd-proteomics/output_files/03-annotated-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

significant_gene_set_enrichment <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05 & kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio > 0.1,]
significant_gene_set_enrichment$Group <- annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df[match(significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df$Term),"Group"]
significant_gene_set_enrichment$ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")
write.csv(significant_gene_set_enrichment, file = file.path(output_dir, "03-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))
# Perform enrichment smplify


```
